title: BuildingOS Digital Twin
summary: BuildingOS is a smart-building platform for property and facility operators. On one commercial tower I helped put six AI agents — one per building system — in front of the facility manager, each grounded in the tower's own documents.

facts.label: Role
facts.value: Product Intern (3 months) — PRDs, API specs, knowledge bases

facts.label: Scope
facts.value: 6 agents · 1,000+ documents · MVAC, electrical, ELV, plumbing & drainage, fire services, lifts

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: BuildingOS · RAG agents · Python · IoT and open-data APIs

sections.heading: Alarm → specialist → sourced answer
paragraphs: A manager spots an alarm on the 3-D twin — an AHU motor trip on a floor. Instead of waiting for the right engineer, they pick the matching specialist agent and ask. The answer comes back with the manual page it came from.

sections.heading: Building the knowledge bases
paragraphs: Python scripts scanned the 1,000+ files, classified each by filename, sorted them into six folders and batch-uploaded them. I then tested retrieval with domain questions until each agent located and cited the right document.

sections.heading: PRDs for the digital twin
paragraphs: For each feature: its purpose, which API endpoints to source — IoT and government open data — how often to poll, how many data points to show, and where in the interface. Product-manager work with an engineering spine.
